hero.headline: Mara ya Tatu.
hero.subhead: Two terms of work for Chilchila, Kipkelion, Kamasian and Kunyak. On 10 August 2027, the third.

slogans._note: Options for the campaign to choose from. Only one ships.
slogans.eNote: Only if the nickname is approved
slogans.f: The first three-term MP for Kipkelion West

one.title: From Koru Farm Primary to the National Assembly
one.body: Koru Farm Primary, Kericho High School, an economics degree from Kenyatta University, then the Kenya Bureau of Standards board. Elected MP in 2017, re-elected in 2022.

two.title: What two terms look like on paper
two.body: NG-CDF allocations approved for Kipkelion West, committee work in two Parliaments, and every figure linked to its source document.

three.title: The third term is for finishing
three.body: Classrooms, bursaries, roads and the coffee and dairy economy. The draft plan is open for your input.

join.title: Be part of the third
join.body: Pledge your vote, volunteer in your ward, or tell us what the next term must deliver.

land.caption: The Kericho highlands: tea, coffee, dairy and hills.
